sentences.text:
For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Hansraj, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Shyameshwar Dayal, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 21-04-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Hisua P.S. Case No. 25 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code and section 23/25 of the P.C& P.N.D.T Act.

As per the prosecution case, one Radha Ultrasound Centre was running in Hisua, where conducting illegal sex determination test of females by Dr. Santosh Kumari.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.

From perusal of the first information report, it would appear that petitioner is not the owner of the Ultrasound Centre and the report was prepared on the half rate of old person, children,
handicapped Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.71100 of 2022(4) dt.21-04-2023 and pregnant lady by Dr. Santosh Kumari.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that due to business rivalry a false case was lodged in Nawada against the petitioner and no other complaint has been filed before the competent authority.

It is further submitted that petitioner has clean antecedent as stated in Shiv Ram Kumar @ Shiv Raj Kumar @ Shivraj vs The State Of Bihar on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151212700/
1 para-3 of this application.

entities.text: Shiv Ram Kumar @ Shiv Raj Kumar @ Shivraj vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances as well as submission of the parties, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/ surrender within four weeks from the date of receipt of this order to the court concerned, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nawada in Hisua P.S. Case No. 25 of 2022 subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) N.K/-
